purpose: Make the local WB read-only pilot accept every uploaded file as an auditable intake object, safely extract usable information from supported direct and archived formats, calculate every independently derivable metric, and report unresolved metrics and required data without aborting unrelated calculations.
source_precedence: Explicit user instruction dated 2026-07-25 for universal file acceptance and maximum available calculations
existing validated safety and financial-domain contracts

semantic_boundary.any_file: Every local file is accepted for classification and auditable registration unless blocked by a security or corruption condition. Acceptance does not mean invented semantic interpretation.
semantic_boundary.supported_extraction: Usable structured data is extracted from safely readable XLSX/XLSM, delimited text, JSON tables, XML tables and supported archives containing such members.
semantic_boundary.unsupported_format: Unsupported or non-tabular files remain registered with explicit reason codes and do not abort processing of other files.
semantic_boundary.archives: ZIP and standard-library TAR/GZIP/BZIP2/XZ containers are inspected with traversal, symlink, executable, encryption, recursion, entry-count, size and compression-ratio limits. Unsupported archive types are registered without guessed contents.
semantic_boundary.partial_calculation: A missing input blocks only metrics whose dependency graph needs that input. Independent observed or derived metrics continue. Partial totals are explicitly labelled and never represented as complete totals.
semantic_boundary.no_specific_report: No fixed Wildberries report identity or exact header hash is required for intake. Known schemas receive stronger semantic mapping; unknown tables preserve observed columns and row counts and can contribute only where aliases establish meaning.
semantic_boundary.no_guessing: Unknown columns, units, currencies, signs, product attribution and business meaning are never inferred without a declared alias or user mapping.

milestones.title: Baseline and exact source reconstruction
requirements: Prove ancestry from f251c9325e701b6cf3de127111b86fe8e2d71269
Inventory all active intake, dispatcher, finance, output, UI and installer paths
Record confirmed gaps before implementation
milestones.pass_criteria: One reproducible baseline and no undocumented implementation scope

milestones.title: Universal file and archive intake
requirements: Accept and register every uploaded file independently
Safely parse XLSX/XLSM, CSV/TSV/delimited text, JSON tables and XML tables
Safely recurse through supported archives within fixed depth and resource limits
Do not let one bad archive member abort usable siblings
Return per-file and per-member status, detected format, extracted table count and reason codes
Preserve unsupported files without sending data externally
tests: one corrupt member with one valid sibling
milestones.pass_criteria: Every input receives an auditable result and all safely usable members continue to downstream processing

milestones.title: Schema-neutral extraction and evidence mapping
requirements: Discover tables without requiring one named WB report
Map financial fields only through explicit normalized aliases and units
Combine complementary fields from multiple files with source provenance
Keep conflicting values separate and report conflict instead of selecting silently
Retain observed row, column, period, product and currency evidence
milestones.pass_criteria: Known evidence is mapped with provenance; unknown meaning remains explicitly unmapped

milestones.title: Maximum available partial calculations
requirements: Do not globally stop calculations because one product, group, row or metric is unresolved
Calculate every metric whose dependencies are valid
Represent each metric as VALID, PARTIAL or BLOCKED
Publish partial totals only with coverage and excluded-scope disclosure
List every unavailable metric and exact missing inputs
Keep unknown or unattributed rows visible as unresolved evidence
Do not fabricate tax, cost, attribution, currency or unit values
Allow pre-tax calculations when tax inputs are absent
Allow observed marketplace metrics when cost inputs are absent
milestones.pass_criteria: No independent valid metric is lost because another metric is blocked, and no partial figure is presented as complete

milestones.title: UI and output disclosure
requirements: Show processed, partially processed, unsupported, quarantined and failed files separately
Show calculated figures before missing-data requests
For every blocked figure show required data and affected scope
Show coverage for partial totals
Keep Excel, JSON and HTML output consistent
Do not expose raw commercial rows unless already permitted by existing policy
milestones.pass_criteria: The operator can distinguish available results, limitations and next required data without reading logs

milestones.title: Red Team plateau and one-click EXE
requirements: Run complete Linux and hosted Windows source gates
Run adversarial file and archive corpus
Build one exact-head Windows installer EXE
Install and run native self-test from the built artifact
Preserve WB_ONLY read-only boundaries
Retain SHA-256 identity and artifact evidence
Repeat Red Team until zero open P0/P1 and zero known reproducible P2 correctness defect
milestones.pass_criteria: A downloadable exact-head one-click EXE exists and all applicable hosted gates pass; physical operator L5 remains separately identified
